response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as baseline_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT ta.type_avg FROM type_averages ta CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ta.type_avg > b.baseline_price), mean_of_above_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as mean_price FROM above_baseline), final_types AS (SELECT ab.type_avg FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN mean_of_above_baseline m WHERE ab.type_avg > m.mean_price) SELECT AVG(ft.type_avg) as avg_type_price, AVG(ft.type_avg) - b.baseline_price as above_baseline, AVG(ft.type_avg) - m.mean_price as above_mean_of_kept FROM final_types ft CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN mean_of_above_baseline m WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL
